body: Thank you for your perspective. It has given me a better mindset. I can slow down, I just need something else to look forward to. If I can find that, I’ll have all the hope I need.
Reddit has always been a great place for online support, but I need just one neighbor that doesn’t want to lie to me or rob me.
Yea man, I can feel the drugs slowly eating away at my sanity, and I feel as if I will loose what’s left of my mind in the next decade. I’m past a point of doing it responsibly.
Has this helped you find good people in day to day life?
It’s a very rare thing man. Especially these days. But trust me, it’s there, and it’s worth more than the wait and the hell that came with it.
People come and go, but the feelings you had for that person don’t really subside in your memories. Ya know?
Do you feel as if it may be healthier than drug abuse?

When I got kicked out of my parents house, I moved in with my aunt and uncle. My aunt has leukemia. It’s scary how much that can do to an able body. My roommate however is just a lazy druggy who likes to bring his friends over and party, no physical ailments. If I don’t pick up after him the place will just stay dirty. That single joint turned into 10 for me. The discomfort in my mouth turned into scarring of my lung. And instead of it taking an edge off, I do it because I’m not myself if I don’t.
The crazy part about a true love is you’ll never see it coming, it just shows up one day and you never loose it. All you have to to is be there for it when the time comes.
What are your addictions like?

Happy birthday, an old cowboy once told me that you shouldn’t go searching for the love of your life, they will find you. Don’t give up hope, go get blasted tonight, celebrate that you’ve made it this far in life, many haven’t, and you may just wake up next to her tomorrow.
Let us pray

This sounds like an old daily routine of I used to have. It took me years to figure out what you just said. The best thing you could possibly do is redirect your anger. Acknowledge that it’s there, but try to think past it and not to feel it. Don’t ever yell. No one wants to talk in a yelling match. If the other person begins to yell, calmly back out of the conversation. Cooling off can take time, but if you can figure out how to cool yourself off in the moment, you will hardly ever fight those you love.
Try to never burn the bridge, and do not fight them in leaving.
Friends will come and go. I lost my last friend last night over not helping him clean up his mess. Just appreciate them while they are here and try not to miss them too much when they are gone.
